title: Sarathi Execution Trace Schema
description: Standardized schema for execution trace records produced by the Sarathi Governance Kernel. This schema defines the integration contract for external systems (InsightFlow, Audit, Compliance) consuming enforcement and execution data.

request.description: The original execution request — immutable after creation

agent_id.description: Unique identifier of the requesting AI agent

resource_id.description: Unique identifier of the target resource

correlation_id.description: Unique correlation identifier for end-to-end tracing

policy_version.description: Requested policy version (optional — empty means use active)

request_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of canonical request fields — immutable binding

is_valid.description: Whether the request passed pre-PDP input validation

enforcement.description: The enforcement adapter's decision record — hash-chained and immutable

decision_id.description: Unique PDP decision identifier (empty for pre-PDP rejections)

enforcement_hash.description: SHA-256 enforcement chain hash — unique per evaluation due to UUID4 nonce

enforcement_nonce.description: UUID4 nonce ensuring hash uniqueness across identical requests

enforcement_stage.description: Which enforcement stage produced this decision

enforcement_reason.description: Human-readable reason for the enforcement decision

policy_version.description: Policy version used for this decision

policy_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the policy used — binds decision to exact policy content

pdp_decision_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the PDP response for integrity verification

determining_rules.description: Rule IDs that determined this verdict

truth_classification.description: Bell-LaPadula classification level of the matching truth

valid_until.description: ISO 8601 TTL expiry timestamp (30s from enforced_at per NIST 800-207)

obligations.description: Mandatory side-effects that must be discharged before execution

has_capability_token.description: Whether a CapabilityToken was issued (true only for ALLOW)

execution.description: The execution engine's result — standardized, deterministic output

executed.description: Whether execution was permitted (true only for valid ALLOW + token)

execution_sequence.description: Monotonic sequence number in execution chain

execution_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of this execution record — links to execution chain

prev_execution_hash.description: Hash of previous execution record — append-only chain linkage

enforcement_hash.description: Enforcement hash that authorized this execution (from CapabilityToken)

token_id.description: CapabilityToken ID used for this execution (present for ALLOW)

block_reason.description: Standardized block reason code (present only for EXECUTION_BLOCKED)

obligations_discharged.description: Obligations discharged before execution was permitted

capability_token.description: The CapabilityToken that authorized execution (present for ALLOW only)
